hooks.command: grep -n 'password\|secret\|api_key\|access_key\|connection_string' "$FILE" | grep -v 'var\.\|data\.\|azurerm_key_vault\|sensitive\|#' | head -5 && echo '⚠ Potential hardcoded secret detected in Terraform file. Use Key Vault or variable with sensitive = true.' || true
hooks.description: Detect hardcoded secrets in Terraform files

hooks.command: grep -n 'public_network_access_enabled.*=.*true\|enable_https_traffic_only.*=.*false\|min_tls_version.*"TLS1_0"\|min_tls_version.*"TLS1_1"' "$FILE" | head -5 && echo '⚠ Security misconfiguration detected. Review public access, HTTPS, and TLS settings.' || true
hooks.description: Detect common security misconfigurations in Terraform

hooks.command: echo '⚠ .tfvars ファイルを作成しようとしています。シークレットを含む場合は .gitignore に追加されていることを確認してください。'

git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null | grep '\.tf$' | xargs grep -l 'sku.*Premium\|sku.*P[0-9]\|vm_size.*Standard_D[0-9]*\|tier.*Premium' 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo '⚠ High-cost SKU detected in modified Terraform files. Verify cost impact with /cost-check.' || true
hooks.description: Check for high-cost resources in modified Terraform files
